description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EntityManagerTrait' within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Traits\ORM. The trait provides a method to retrieve the Doctrine EntityManager from the service container, facilitating ORM operations within classes that use this trait.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine EntityManager or EntityManagerInterface instance by retrieving it from the service container via the Services::DOCTRINE key.
